text.value: Define the records and actions that each integration needs to exchange. Document inputs, validation, expected responses and failure behavior.

text.label: p · Confirm the systems, accounts and interfaces needed for the connection
text.value: Confirm the systems, accounts and interfaces needed for the connection. Test both successful workflows and unavailable-service scenarios.

text.value: Define handover and support around the project requirements. Agree the expected behavior, implementation details and review criteria before the build.
